What you will learn in this class is that these three concepts come from a revolution in human thought called monotheism—the one true God. This idea of montheism forever changed the course of human history, giving us concepts of money, individual identity, and nation state. Montheism is such a powerful idea that it turned nothing into everything.

Christianity is like one of three great monotheistic religions—Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. What I will show you later on is that they are essentially the same religion. I don't want to give you too much information because it's a lot to process, but I want you guys to remember: concepts of money, individual identity, and initial state are all powerful ideas embedded into everyday life. You cannot escape them.

What power truly is can be compared to alchemy throughout human history—the pursuit of turning lead into gold. Alchemy was the quest for converting nothing into everything. And maybe in science class, you were taught that alchemy is a fake science, pseudo-science. It didn't work.

What you will learn in this class is that we achieve alchemy. We turn nothing into everything. Power is the capacity to make you believe that money is valuable, that individual identity can lead to happiness, and that nation states exist. As a result, today we live extremely miserable lives because you've been taught to think that life just gets better and better.

What's really important is that you will also learn in this class that this was an accident—an accident of the human imagination. It happened because we didn't know what we were doing when creating this system. So, you'll learn that you can control the human imagination and use it to create a new system allowing for udeimmonia or the flourishing of the human intellect.

Any questions? That's it for today. Okay, I'll see you guys next class.
